# Resultar

> Typed, composable error handling for TypeScript: explicit `Result` values, lazy `ResultTask`
> workflows with typed services and scopes, awaitable `ResultAsync`, tagged errors, and
> compiler-backed diagnostics. Node.js 24+, ESM-only.

## Installed version first

For an npm installation, read `node_modules/resultar/dist/llms.txt` and
`node_modules/resultar/dist/agent/SKILL.md`. These files ship with the installed version, along
with a compiled workflow recipe and `versions.json` for companion-package compatibility.
The links below follow development on `main`; they are not a substitute for versioned local types.

## Start here

- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/skills/resultar/SKILL.md): opinionated defaults and pointers for coding agents.
- [Core package README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/resultar/README.md): model, ResultTask, services, scopes, decision guide.
- [Full guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/DOCUMENTATION.md): complete API map and recipes.

## Packages

- [resultar-di](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/di/README.md): typed composition, lifetimes, overrides.
- [DI composition and framework adapters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/di/ADVANCED.md): named registration, scope.fetch and provider access, all exported by resultar-di.
- [resultar-hono](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/hono/README.md): Hono bindings, one scope per response, CloseError.
- [resultar-fastify](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/fastify/README.md): native plugins, application/request services, cancellation and cleanup.
- [resultar-request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/request/README.md) with [TypeBox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/request-typebox/README.md) and [Zod](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/request-zod/README.md) adapters.
- [resultar-check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/packages/check/README.md): native diagnostics, including the no-discard rule.

## Examples

- [Core cookbook](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/resultar/README.md) including the [application lifecycle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/resultar/src/application-lifecycle.ts) (database, session, HTTP scope ordering).
- [Hono app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/hono/README.md): matching service classes, AppHono inferred in main.ts and native routes.
- [request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/request/README.md), [check](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/check/README.md).
- [Fastify app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/examples/fastify/README.md): class services with requires, function-based health, TypeBox routes and request.services inferred in main.ts.

## Design records (history, not usage truth)

- [RFC 0001](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/rfcs/rfc-0001-result-task-core.md): ResultTask architecture. Phases 0-2 done; Phase 3 partial (no fibers, race, timeout, or scheduler on ResultTask).
- [RFC 0002](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/rfcs/rfc-0002-di-lifetimes-scopes.md): DI lifetimes and request scopes (implemented).
- [RFC 0003](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaiat/resultar/main/docs/rfcs/rfc-0003-phase-3-remainder-and-validation.md): remaining work tracker.

## Freshness rule

Package READMEs and `packages/di/ADVANCED.md` override `DOCUMENTATION.md`; both override the
skill; RFCs are design history. The installed `node_modules` types always win over any document.
